projects.name: CoreWeave HPC hosting contracts
projects.quote: Up to $1.5 million per HPC MW (or approximately $750 million) of data center build out costs are funded by CoreWeave and credited against hosting payments at no more than 50% of monthly fees until fully repaid.

projects.name: Denton, Texas HPC data center expansion
projects.quote: Note: All figures are as of 2/26/25; Includes ~100 MW gross capacity / ~70 MW critical IT load expansion at Denton site; Also includes Austin, Texas site representing 20MW gross capacity / ~18 MW critical IT load.

projects.name: Austin, Texas HPC data center
projects.quote: HPC hosting costs at our Austin, Texas data center consist primarily of lease expense, the direct pass-through of power costs, and direct and indirect facilities operations expenses, including personnel and benefit costs and stock- based compensation.

projects.name: Auburn, Alabama HPC data center
projects.quote: Signed a lease (includes option to buy) for an existing data center with 11 MW of current critical IT load in Auburn, Alabama
